fusions.name: Tucked Coal
fusions.desc: A hidden stab that deals 8 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, consuming every affliction already on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Thrown From the Sleeve
fusions.desc: Flicks a heated blade that deals 22 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Whetted in Coals
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Seared Shut
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
